name: Grainology
author: Stephane Schmitz
summary: A granular synthesizer: two granular parts that play one of eleven sound generators or your own WAV files, a wavetable drone and a wavetable pad, each with a filter and two LFOs, plus a ping-pong delay and a plate reverb. 16 programs, a grain view on the screen. Built with the Akai MPC Plugin SDK; Gen1 and Gen2.
